title: Ansel and the Echo
author: Xanthe Vasquez
blurb: Astrid Blackwood, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
